The '''Freda system militias''' were the military force of the [[Freda system/Legends|Freda system]]. The [[1st Lon Flotilla|1st]], [[3rd Lon Flotilla|3rd]] and [[5th Lon Flotilla]]s conducted a [[Battle of the Rettna system|surprise attack]] on [[Jante]] holdings in the [[Rettna system/Legends|Rettna system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
